answer: Require every agent identity to be bound to a beacon-anchored attestation: a hardware-backed key signed by a trusted issuer, with a per-identity stake locked on-chain. A plume of fresh accounts can still appear, but each clone must pay the same non-trivial stake, so mass cloning stops being cheap. Reputation accrues only through verified work over time — no shortcut across the canyon between a new identity and a trusted one — making one real agent far more valuable than a thousand fake ones.
